home.title: Environmental data, shared responsibly.
home.subtitle: Browse the region's geospatial holdings — boundaries, forest cover, watersheds, protected areas and more. Source files are released by request only.
home.cta_body: Every file is released through a reviewed request. Tell us what you need and how it will be used.
home.notice_title: Preview only — this is not a download site
home.notice_body: Every map here is a generalized preview. Source shapefiles remain in DENR custody and are released only after a request is reviewed and approved.
home.how_1_body: Search or filter the catalog by province, theme or geometry type.
home.how_2_body: Tell us who you are and what the data is for. Be specific — vague requests are declined.
home.how_3_body: A DENR Region VII reviewer checks the request against the data sharing terms.
home.how_4_body: If approved, you receive a reference number and the data through the agreed channel.
home.featured_body: A sample of what is available.

about.title: About ENVIS
about.lead: ENVIS is the environment and natural resources information system of DENR Region VII. This portal is its public catalog: it shows what geospatial data exists, who owns it, and how to request it.
about.s1_body: A catalog and preview surface for Region VII geospatial datasets. Every entry carries metadata, a data dictionary and a generalized map preview.
about.s2_body: It is not a download site. Source shapefiles are held by DENR Region VII and are released only after a written request is reviewed and approved.
about.s3_body: Preview geometry is simplified and rounded to roughly 110 metres so it can never substitute for the delivered dataset. Attribute fields that identify individuals or claimant groups are withheld.
about.s4_body: Datasets are owned by DENR Region VII and its bureaus. Custody is assigned to the division named on each dataset page.
about.s5_body: For questions about a request, quote your reference number and write to the Regional Planning and Information Unit at geocheckcentralvisayas@gmail.com.

terms.title: Data sharing terms
terms.lead: These terms apply to every dataset released through ENVIS.
terms.s1_body: Approved data may be used only for the purpose stated in the request. New uses require a new request.
terms.s2_body: You may not republish, resell or share the source files with third parties without written permission from DENR Region VII.
terms.s3_body: Any map, report or publication derived from the data must credit the Department of Environment and Natural Resources, Region VII.
terms.s4_body: Data is provided as-is. It is not a land survey, not a legal boundary determination, and not a substitute for an official certification.
terms.s5_body: DENR Region VII may withdraw approval if these terms are breached. You must then delete the files and confirm deletion in writing.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.lead: What we collect when you request a dataset, and why.
privacy.s1_body: Your name, email, organization, position, purpose and intended use, plus the dataset requested and an optional area of interest.
privacy.s2_body: To assess the request, to contact you about it, and to keep an audit record of who received which dataset.
privacy.s3_body: Requests are stored in a local database operated by DENR Region VII. They are not shared with third parties.
privacy.s4_body: Request records and their review history are retained as part of the data release audit trail.
privacy.s5_body: You may ask for a correction or a copy of your request record by quoting your reference number.
